lines.text: Greetings, Endmin. Is everything going well for you?
Actually, yes... I'm working on improving some emergency meds and need a few herbal samples for experiments.
But things are hectic at the Worker Dorms, so I can't leave right now.
Perfect! I'll send you the herb locations. It might take you some time to gather them all.
Thank you so much, Endmin! Oh, most grow in remote spots, so please be careful out there.

options: Everything's fine. How about you? Need any help?
